current.text: If he earns a role, he could make about 2.5 threes in 20 minutes and add little else.
His dynasty rookie rank is 31. It did not change after Summer League.
Minnesota's bench is thin with little scoring punch, and the team needs wing depth.
Yahoo projects only a small bench role for him. He is not a draft target in a 12-team league.

durable.text: He is an older prospect from the 2026 draft class.
He takes a very large share of his shots from three. In Summer League, 10 of his 14 shots were threes.
Before the draft he made his threes at a high rate. In Summer League he shot 21%.
He is a pure volume shooter who gives little outside of threes.
